summary: Coecke-Sadrzadeh-Clark 2010 DisCoCat: the free pregroup as a proof-relevant calculus (Red : Ty -> Ty -> Type with integer adjoint iterators; Le its inhabited Prop shadow) with preorder/tensor/substitutivity, adjoint cancellation, the compound anti-homomorphism laws, compound contraction/expansion (T4), contravariance (T7), uniqueness of adjoints (T8), and the fidelity theorem that Le is NOT antisymmetric on strings (the poset quotient is deliberately never formed); the heterogeneous equational theory deq of the free strict compact closed category (congruence, category laws, strict monoidal laws, interchange, cast-invisibility, the four yanking equations); all readings/bracketings of the 'John likes Mary' reduction proved deq-equal; the concrete model FVect_Q as phantom-dimension matrices with row-major Kronecker (category laws, interchange, STRICT monoidal laws on the nose, both snake shapes at every dimension, eps = inner product, trace = dimension); the meaning functor F by structural recursion, strictly monoidal on objects, with the soundness theorem F_deq — derivations equal in the free compact closed category have equal matrices, for ALL reductions — and sentence-level meaning invariance; worked examples computed exactly by vm_compute (Example 1/1b true and false instances, intransitive, the graded 3/4-1/4 sentence, exact inner products 3/4, 1/4, 0, and 512-column computational reflection of reading-equality).

Lambek, J. (2008). From Word to Sentence.
Preller, A. & Lambek, J. (2007). Free compact 2-categories. MSCS 17.
Sadrzadeh, M., Clark, S. & Coecke, B. (2013). The Frobenius anatomy of word meanings I. JLC.
Coecke, B., Grefenstette, E. & Sadrzadeh, M. (2013). Lambek vs Lambek. APAL 164.

definitions_mapped.coq: Simple := B * Z; ladj/radj as pred/succ; Ty := list Simple; ladj_ty := rev(map ladj)
definitions_mapped.source: PL07 p. 316 iterated adjoints; L08 ch. 4
definitions_mapped.note: (a^l)^r = a is an honest equality by lia

definitions_mapped.coq: Red : Ty -> Ty -> Type (7 constructors, structural steps indexed by ladj/radj); Le := inhabited Red
definitions_mapped.note: Type so F can eliminate; the indexing makes all four snakes cast-free (artifact ii)
heterogeneity avoids transports; completeness for planar diagrams (Preller) NOT proved

definitions_mapped.coq: mat m n := nat -> nat -> Q (phantom dims); mmul k; kron m2 n2 (row-major); eps/eta as delta row/column
definitions_mapped.note: phantom dims make the monoidal structure strict on the nose; dimension errors are not type errors — correctness carried by mat_eq (artifact ii)

definitions_mapped.coq: dimS ignores the iterator; dimT by fold; F : Red p q -> mat (dimT q) (dimT p) by structural recursion
definitions_mapped.note: F(x^l) = F(x) is definitional, so the self-duality is not a theorem (artifact ii)

definitions_mapped.coq: tensor_words as right fold with FULL-tail kron dims; meaning := mmul (F d) (tensor_words ws)
Examples: basic := Bn|Bs|Bj|Bsig; tv/iv/adj/does/not/like types; dim1/dim2; likes/loves/hates/likes_g truth-table vectors
definitions_mapped.note: V(men)/W(women) collapse to N — the functor forces it (SCC13 §4), documented

evidence: The four snake constructors typecheck cast-free with a symbolic simple type, exactly as the design's probe predicted, and F_deq covers every deq axiom including all four yanking cases.
Every numeric example of CSC10 §4-5 is reproduced exactly by vm_compute.
All 25 audited theorems closed under the global context.
simplifications: closed sentence forms (CSC10 §4.1 p. 18 general formula) exercised at fixed dimensions per the design's fallback clause S6 — the general symbolic closed form is deferred
exact rational inner products instead of normalised cosines (Q has no sqrt; the paper normalises implicitly)
omissions: Preller's completeness of deq for planar diagrams; Buszkowski decidability; the poset quotient (deliberate, T9)
STRETCH: negative-sentence computation, Frobenius relative pronouns, Lambek single-step equivalence, ordered basic types, parser, semiring/FRel (full plans in designs/discocat.md S1-S7)
additions: deq_cast + F_cast making casts semantically invisible
computational reflection layer (mat_eqb) tying deq consequences to vm_compute

determination_rationale: The calculus, the equational theory, the strict model and the sound meaning map go through with zero axioms; the two encoding moves with content (phantom dimensions; heterogeneous deq) are exactly what makes the STRICT structure of the source honest in Coq, and both are documented artifact classes.

artifact_classes.description: checked absence: no positivity workaround needed anywhere
Red in Type with Le = inhabited shadow; phantom-dimension matrices (dimension errors not type errors; mat_eq carries correctness); F(x^l)=F(x) definitional
Qeq setoid; junk outside bounds; everything on the vm path transparent; unary div/mod bounds example sizes
no category/functor classes, no dependent matrices, no bigops, no quotients — every law a named theorem
derivations hand-written (sound parser is STRETCH); mat_eqb decides semantic equality at fixed dims where syntactic deq is not decided

source_gap.detail: CSC10 p. 14 has eps^r_n (x) 1_s (x) eps^l_n where SCC13 §4 prints eps^r twice (a typo there); constructors follow CSC10 and in the model both are eps — commented, not fixed.
